title: DaylightPaint Command
description: Replace the daylight overlay: delete forsk:kind=analysis objects, then add one vertex-coloured mesh on A-ANALYSE that fills each room to its inner wall faces, one flat colour per cell (a cell's vertices are its own). Display mode 'Forsk Analysis': mesh wires off, unlit vertex colours. The layer is off in every layout detail and does not print. An estimated daylight factor, not a simulation.

z.description: Mesh height in mm, usually the floor plus 50.

vertices.description: Mesh vertices [x, y] in mm: each cell's own corners, on the lattice and on the room outlines.

colors.description: One Forsk sky ramp colour per vertex, the same for every vertex of a cell: DF / 5 %.

faces.description: Triangles and quads of vertex indices.
